reusable_lessons.lesson: Run forge with tsx until recipe input schemas ship compiled JS siblings.
reusable_lessons.fed_back: Captured in golden-path script command path.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Generated Next apps should use top-level typedRoutes and explicit outputFileTracingRoot.
Local runtime proof needs a generated .env.local with safe mock values when using mock secrets.
reusable_lessons.fed_back: Golden-path runner writes staging credentials when configured, otherwise public-safe mock env, and keeps both out of committed artifacts.

remaining_gaps: No public Vercel preview was created because VERCEL_TOKEN is not set in this shell.
